Faculty Vacancy
Thursday, 24 October 2024
4338 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram invites applications for the followings post in the prescribed proforma (
Available here
). The application along with all certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of:
The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS), 442102
latest by 9
th
November 2024. The appointments would be on adhoc basis till the next Selection Committee meeting of MUHS.
Assistant Professor (Super-specialty)
– Cardiology-1, Cardiac Surgery-1, Pediatric Cardiology-1, Cardiac Anesthesia-1, Gastroenterology-1 and Nephrology-1
Associate Professor
–Surgery-1
Assistant Professor
– ENT-1, Medicine-4, Surgery-4, Orthopaedics-1, Anaesthesiology-1, Radiodiagnosis-1 and Skin & VD-1.
Senior Resident
–Medicine-1, Surgery-3, Orthopaedics-1, Psychiatry-1, Anaesthesiology-3, Radiotherapy-1, Anatomy-2, Physiology-2, Biochemistry-2, Microbiology-1, Forensic Medicine -2 and Pharmacology-2.
Qualification
:
for 1:
MBBS with MD/MS and DM/M Ch in concerned subject or equivalent with one year Experience in Medical College post super specialization for concerned faculty position.
for 2 & 3:
MBBS with MD/MS in the concerned subject or equivalent, experience and other requirement as per NMC and MUHS norms.
for 4:
MBBS with NMC recognized Post-Graduate Degree or equivalent in concerned subject.
Experience  :
As per NMC & MUHS norms
PAY SCALE  :
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
